purpose: SCNet LS-DYNA candidate evidence inventory for calibrating the UAV damage-engine project

scnet_live_observations.observation: The SCNet ANSYS LS-DYNA template exposed V231,user on the xahcnormal CPU resource. The template accepted .key, .k, .inc and .dyn inputs.
The running job script enforced an authorization flag, source-manifest hash, input-deck hash, source-gate hash and executable hash before launching the solver.

The completed glstat download did not complete within the browser timeout. After that attempt, browser-origin access to SCNet was denied, so no result file was retrieved and no additional paid job was submitted.

local_evidence.finding: Two armor objects and 67 components use unverified demo response identities and provisional imported damage-tree semantics.
Fragment source, ballistic response, component response and blast response parameters are explicitly marked unverified or DEMO-NOT-VALIDATED.
The current 5000-case archive is internally consistent but not research-admitted; four system outputs are constant zero, one is extremely sparse, and every case uses two Monte Carlo replicates.
Current component-response support is K=28, M=2205, F=28 and C=0; K and F positives are the same 28 cases.
The legacy seven outputs cannot be relabeled in place as four ordered two-level KMFC pairs.
The training-readiness audit failed closed because formal result files do not contain replicate traces.
